extracted.name: Popcorn muesli
extracted.description: Make a batch of muesli that uses popcorn as a crunchy base. Enjoy with bio yoghurt for a healthy start to the day. It will store in a jar for up to five days
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp toasted three-seed mix (ours included flaxseed and pumpkin and sunflower seeds)
instruction_lines: Combine the oats, seed mix, popcorn, sultanas and walnuts. Will keep in a sealed jar or airtight container for up to five days.
When you’re ready to serve, spoon the yogurt into bowls, then scatter over the muesli and pour over a little milk to loosen, if you like.
